paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Paper constrains axionlike DM coupling to polarized electrons via 'wind' effect, reported as F_a/C_e >= 2e15 eV (over much of range), equivalently C_e/F_a <= 5e-16 eV^-1. The y-axis of Fig.5 is C_e/F_a in eV^-1, NOT the conventional dimensionless g_ae. Data points listed are C_e/F_a (eV^-1) at the limit ~5e-16 eV^-1 across mass range; actual exclusion plot has structure near 47 zeV (sidereal bump) and rises at high mass due to attenuation. Numerical values approximate from text limit F_a/C_e ~ 2 PeV = 2e15 eV. Coupling type mapping to standard g_ae is non-trivial; treated as AxionElectron per hint.
